thread:
ana (product): Quick sync: we need a single, customer-friendly lexicon for when we serve a cheaper/compatibility variant and decide what telemetry/headers we expose. Small decision: phrasing + minimal API surface.

sam (eng-platform): Agreed. Keep it small: HTTP 200, small route metadata, and an opt-in verbose warning. Avoid adding new status codes.

tess (eng-runtime): runtime currently logs ROUTE_COMPAT and ROUTE_OVERFLOW. We can map to public `serve_variant` values: `primary`, `compat`, `cached`. Implementation: add trace tag rw.serve_variant and emit counter rw.variant.count.

lee (devex): please do not expose raw model ids. UI should show friendly labels like "compat" or "cached". Tooltip copy suggestion: "Served from compatibility variant to preserve latency/SLOs." No site-wide banners under 2% of traffic.

ryan (eng-sre): Telemetry/alerts: expose metrics `rw.variant.count`, `rw.variant.rate_pct`, `rw.variant.latency_p95`. Alert thresholds: warn at 4% sustained 6h, critical at 18% sustained 24h. Add a `rw.variant.bucket` tag: 0-1,1-5,5-20,20+.

sam (eng-platform): API surface proposal: header `X-RW-Serve-Variant: compat|primary|cached` plus response metadata \"serve_variant\":{\"kind\":\"compat\",\"label\":\"compat\"}. Add per-customer config `expose_serve_variant: none|label|full`. Hosted default = label. Dedicated can opt into full (hashed ids).

manual example (sam): ```
Headers:
  X-RW-Serve-Variant: compat
Response payload snippet:
  {"status":"ok","serve_variant":{"kind":"compat","label":"compat"}}
```

ana (product): love avoid the word "fallback" for customer copy. Prefer "compatibility variant" or "compat mode" in the console. For API docs we can explain semantics: served to preserve latency, output should be considered functionally equivalent but may differ subtly; clients should not auto-retry.

marco (solutions): Add `X-RW-Serve-Note` header only for verbose mode (per-request query `?variant_verbose=1`) with a short human phrase when enabled. Useful for debugging customer repros.

tess (eng-runtime): runtime will add sampling for degraded responses: sample ids exported to secure bucket. Sampling policy: up to 500/day per org or 0.05% of variant requests, whichever is smaller.

ryan (eng-sre): Runbook trigger: if variant_rate_bucket == 20+ and model-quality-regression alert fires, auto-open P1 and attach sampled ids. Also nightly job to run evals on a subset of sampled compat responses.

lee (devex): Console UX: per-route pill: "Compat mode (2.4%)" with hover details and link to runbook. Add small per-route sparklines for fallback_pct. Provide opt-in verbose toggle on org settings to include warnings in responses.

sam (eng-platform): Decision point: return HTTP 200 with metadata vs 2xx + warning header. I vote 200 + metadata to avoid breaking clients.

ana (product): +1 — 200 + metadata + optional verbose warning. I'll write short helptext and runbook blurb.

ci-bot (ci): QA build for serve-variant flag green.

sam (eng-platform): Owners: sam RFC + API docs, lee console, ryan alerts/sampling jobs, tess runtime sampling. Ship plan: internal canary 48h -> alpha opt-in -> GA. Review RFC in 72h.

all: +1
